contracts: (SnapshotBoundaryTests discovery is nonzero and the absolute-path assertion executes against the real Snapshot entry point.) AND (SnapshotBoundaryTests discovery is nonzero and the link-exclusion assertion executes against the real Snapshot entry point.) AND (SnapshotBoundaryTests discovery is nonzero and the source-data retention assertion executes against the real Snapshot entry point.) AND (SnapshotBoundaryTests discovery is nonzero and the test-data retention assertion executes against the real Snapshot entry point.) AND (SnapshotBoundaryTests 的制品密钥边界选择器在实际生成制品上通过，且扫描未发现明文密钥。) AND (SnapshotBoundaryTests 的清单密钥边界选择器在实际清单上通过，且扫描未发现明文密钥。) AND (The exact selector is discovered and reports nonzero assertions for every required category.) AND (The exact targeted selector is discovered with nonzero count and confirms manifest and server Project IDs match.) AND (The exact targeted selector is discovered with nonzero count and verifies both compatibility fields.) AND (The exact targeted selector is discovered with nonzero count and verifies key-reference presence and plaintext-key absence.) AND (The manifest hash selector executes and verifies hash presence and binding.) AND (The manifest identity selector executes and confirms a stable Snapshot ID independent of placement/runtime metadata.) AND (The targeted W05 selector is discovered and verifies explicit content exclusions; a missing declaration fails it.) AND (The targeted W05 selector verifies creation-action provenance; missing provenance fails it.) AND (The targeted W05 selector verifies creator provenance; missing provenance fails it.) AND (The targeted W05 selector verifies retention information; missing retention data fails it.) AND (The targeted manifest selector is discovered and verifies non-empty recovery/rebuild instructions.) AND (The targeted selector is discovered, executes against a real published manifest, and records a non-skipped assertion for applicable recovery conditions/prerequisites.) AND (The targeted selector is discovered, runs against a real published manifest, and emits a non-skipped assertion proving normalized content inventory/index.) AND (The targeted selector is discovered, runs against a real published manifest, and proves stable Account ID presence and server derivation.) AND (The targeted selector is discovered, runs on a real published manifest, and records a non-skipped assertion for explicit creation-time provenance.) AND (The targeted test discovers and executes ownership and ACL-reference assertions against the published manifest.) AND (The targeted test discovers and executes the Workspace-ID assertion and observes the stable identifier.) AND (The targeted test discovers and executes the content-size assertion and observes a recorded size.) AND (The targeted test discovers and executes the schema-version assertion and observes a declared version.) AND (目标规范夹具选择器被发现、执行且确认加密配置为已接受的密钥引用。)
selector_intents: PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests creates a mixed fixture containing a link, invokes the real Snapshot entry point, and asserts no link entry or linked content is published.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests creates a mixed fixture containing an absolute path, invokes the real Snapshot entry point, and asserts the produced Snapshot and manifest omit that value.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests creates a mixed fixture with supported persistent source data, invokes the real Snapshot entry point, and asserts that data is retained.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests creates a mixed fixture with supported persistent test data, invokes the real Snapshot entry point, and asserts that data is retained.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests.ManifestContainsApplicableKeyReference
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests.ManifestContainsPlatformAndStorageCompatibility
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests.ManifestContainsStableProjectId
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests.SnapshotBoundary_ExcludesUnsafeContent asserts inventory entries for every supported and prohibited category in one fixture.
Run manifest verification against a manifest missing ownership or ACL-policy references; the assertion fails at the manifest boundary.
Run manifest verification against a manifest whose Workspace ID is absent or placement-derived; the assertion fails at the manifest boundary.
Run manifest verification against a manifest with missing content size; the assertion fails at the manifest boundary.
Run manifest verification against a manifest with no schema version; the assertion fails at the manifest boundary.
Run the Manifest_ContainsRequiredRecoveryContract content-inventory selector against the newly published manifest; fail when inventory/index is absent or not normalized.
Run the Manifest_ContainsRequiredRecoveryContract creation-time selector; fail when the manifest omits or leaves creation time unbound.
Run the Manifest_ContainsRequiredRecoveryContract recovery-prerequisites selector; fail when declarations are absent, empty, or not applicable to the Snapshot.
Run the Manifest_ContainsRequiredRecoveryContract stable-Account selector; fail when Account ID is absent, caller-controlled, or not persisted in the manifest.
Run the W05 manifest verification selector against a manifest without creation-action provenance; the creation-action assertion fails.
Run the W05 manifest verification selector against a manifest without creator provenance; the creator assertion fails.
Run the W05 manifest verification selector against a manifest without declared content exclusions; the exclusion assertion fails.
Run the W05 manifest verification selector against a manifest without retention information; the retention assertion fails.
Run the manifest contract selector against a published manifest whose recovery/rebuild instructions are absent or empty; observe rejection.
Run the manifest identity selector against a manifest with no stable Snapshot ID or only placement/runtime identifiers; observe rejection.
Run the manifest integrity selector against a manifest with omitted content hashes; observe rejection.
扫描 Snapshot 和 Restore 清单；任一清单包含明文密钥即失败。
运行规范夹具密钥引用断言；未使用已接受的密钥引用配置时失败。
针对生成的 Snapshot 或 Restore 制品运行明文密钥扫描；检测到明文密钥即失败。
